items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Your engineer is Richard B. Alon.

ctx.x: Your engineer is Richard B. Alon. We're not calling Joseph. We're singing this evening. That's Sandra Jaffe. Say your name, huh? Everybody should have their name. Sandra Jaffe. How do you spell that? J-A-F-F-E. And your name? Alan Jaffe. John Rice-Leavy. Great spell. G-R-I-C-E? Yeah, I know. We can have it all. Okay. Now you're going to ask him about some tunk we were talking about.
